still sees every protected call but suppresses its healing interventions (automated retries,
dead-letter writes, and the circuit breaker's recording and rejecting) and logs each one it held back

claims.claim: 보류된 조치는 execution_mode.intervention_suppressed 로그로 남는다.

Each held-back intervention is logged at INFO as

claims.claim: fallback=과 timeout=은 dry-run에서도 계속 적용된다.

claims.meaning_ko: BALDUR_MIDDLEWARE_RATE_LIMIT_CODES의 기본값은 429이다.

claims.claim: 예외로 던져진 429는 @baldur.protected(..., retry=True)에서 자동으로 재시도된다.

runs and, unless it is an exhausted quota, the call is tried again once the

is a value, so the retry stage hands it back to your code as the result:

claims.meaning_ko: 반환된 429는 값이므로 재시도 단계가 결과로 코드에 돌려준다. 조정은 되지만 재시도되지 않는다.

raise:

claims.claim: @baldur.protected 밖의 함수는 RateLimitCoordinator.get_instance()의 @coordinator.rate_limit_aware로 대기 시간을 기다리고 429를 보고하며 재시도는 하지 않는다.

claims.evidence: | Per protected call, full chain over Redis | **+1.4 to +1.8 ms of CPU** | 2026-08-28 | What the whole framework adds to one request, against the same application with Baldur removed, when the protected call carries both the dead-letter and the idempotency decorators, so the path makes three Redis round trips instead of none. Two independent runs licensed it; they landed 28% apart, which is why it is published as a range and not a point.
